name: code-server
readme_excerpt: code-server Run VS Code on any machine anywhere and access it in the browser. Highlights - Code on any device with a consistent development environment - Use cloud servers to speed up tests, compilations, downloads, and more - Preserve battery life when you're on the go; all intensive tasks run on your server Requirements See requirements for minimum specs, as well as instructions on how to set up a Google VM on which you can install code-server.
